pages.text: The $(thing)Universal Pipe$() is a single conduit that carries items, fluids, and energy through one network at the same time. Pipes only move the network around; a $(thing)Pipe Connector$() is what actually talks to an adjacent block.

Connect pipes together and they merge into one network. Every connector on that network shares the same items, fluids, and energy. Place a connector against any inventory, tank, or energy machine to interface with it.$(br)$(br)Open a connector's GUI to configure it.

A fresh connector transports nothing. Tick $(l)Items$(), $(l)Fluids$(), or $(l)Energy$() to permit each medium independently.$(br)$(br)All three inert until authorized. (The safety interlock nobody reads.)

Cycle transfer direction: $(l)Disabled$(), $(l)Pull$() (out of the attached block), $(l)Push$() (into it), or $(l)Auto$() (let the block decide).$(br)$(br)Set $(l)Redstone: Ignored$() to always run, or $(l)Redstone: Required$() to run only on a signal.
